newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: CS Holding takes step to new structure.
newsitem.headline: CS Holding takes step to new structure.

text.p: Banking group CS Holding took another formal legal step towards its reorganisation as the renamed Credit Suisse Group when an extraordinary general meeting approved the restructuring proposals on Wednesday.

Flagship bank Credit Suisse, in which CS Holding has 99.99 percent, said in a statement its general meeting approved all proposals by its board of directors, which echoed those of the related CS Holding board.
CS Holding's own extraordinary shareholder meeting approved the reorganisation on October 11.
The Credit Suisse statement said the Wednesday meeting approved an authorised capital increase of not more than one billion Swiss francs.
"This authorised capital will be used to take over the investment banking business of the current CS First Boston from the Credit Suisse Group," it added.

CS Holding will change to Credit Suisse Group as of January 1 and operate four divisions within two banks -- Credit Suisse and Credit Suisse First Boston, both remaining Swiss banks registered under Swiss law with headquarters in Zurich.
